## Summary

What changed, and why it was necessary.

## Findings and ADRs

By number, with one line each.

## Red → green

How the gates failed before the change and pass after it. If a gate was
already green and stayed green, say which one covers this and why.

## Not verified

What this change does not establish. An honest gap here is worth more than a
confident summary — say what the tests could not reach, what only runs on one
platform, and anything a reviewer would otherwise have to guess at.
